Around [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] conducted a '''counterattack''' to retake territory that [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] had seized during a series of [[Minos Cluster incursions|incursions]] into the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]]. The New Republic forces were successful in pushing Sarne's forces back to the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]].
